summary: Iteration 2 re-test after iteration 1 fixes. ALL THREE critical/high backend bugs are fixed and verified. Backend pytest 34/34 PASS (100%). Frontend smoke flow PASS: login -> /dashboard URL, KPIs/charts render, scanner submit navigates to /catalogs/{id}, catalogs CRUD, issue & return, reports CSV/XLSX/PDF all working. 0 console errors during the flow.

minor.issue: Cookies still set with secure=False (httpOnly + samesite=lax). Should be secure=True over HTTPS for hardening. Low risk in preview env.

action_items: Optional: harden cookies to secure=True when running over HTTPS (low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 940 lines - growing. Recommend splitting into auth/, catalogs/, reports/, scans/ modules before the next feature.
doc_to_json() is applied consistently in /scans now; good.
Brute-force identifier is now email-only which works behind ingress. Consider adding optional X-Forwarded-For trust if you also want IP-based throttling.
audit() still uses request.client.host without proxy handling - audit IPs in DB will show k8s pod IPs not real client IPs. Not critical but worth honoring X-Forwarded-For when behind ingress.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, dashboard KPIs+charts, scanner -> catalog detail, catalogs list, issues page, reports page; 0 console errors)
